name: mpesa-mcp
description: MCP server for M-PESA (Safaricom Daraja) and Africa's Talking. 22 tools covering payments (STK Push, B2C, B2B, Pochi), standing orders (Ratiba), Bill Manager invoicing, Dynamic QR, tax remittance, SIM swap fraud detection, IMSI KYC, and SMS/airtime across 20+ African markets.

tools.name: mpesa_stk_push
tools.description: Trigger M-PESA STK Push payment prompt on customer's phone

tools.name: mpesa_stk_query
tools.description: Check STK Push status — poll 10-30s after push

tools.name: mpesa_b2c
tools.description: Business-to-Customer disbursement — payroll, NGO incentives, agent float

tools.name: mpesa_business_paybill
tools.description: B2B payment from shortcode to paybill number

tools.name: mpesa_business_buygoods
tools.description: B2B payment to till/buy-goods number

tools.name: mpesa_business_pochi
tools.description: Pay to Pochi la Biashara micro-SME wallet

tools.name: mpesa_transaction_status
tools.description: Query any M-PESA transaction by receipt number

tools.name: mpesa_account_balance
tools.description: Query business account balance (async)

tools.name: mpesa_query_org_info
tools.description: Validate a shortcode — returns registered name and tariff

tools.name: mpesa_pull_transactions
tools.description: Pull C2B reconciliation records by date range

tools.name: mpesa_reversal
tools.description: Reverse an erroneous M-PESA transaction

tools.name: mpesa_dynamic_qr
tools.description: Generate Dynamic QR code — returns base64 PNG for POS/receipts

tools.name: mpesa_tax_remittance
tools.description: Remit tax directly to Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA shortcode 572572)

tools.name: mpesa_b2b_express_checkout
tools.description: USSD Push to till — merchant-to-merchant payment prompt

tools.name: mpesa_ratiba_create
tools.description: Create M-PESA Ratiba standing order — recurring payments (daily/weekly/monthly)

tools.name: mpesa_bill_manager_optin
tools.description: Enrol business in M-PESA Bill Manager

tools.name: mpesa_bill_manager_invoice
tools.description: Create customer invoice — triggers SMS payment notification

tools.name: mpesa_bill_manager_cancel
tools.description: Cancel outstanding Bill Manager invoice

tools.name: mpesa_sim_swap_query
tools.description: Detect recent SIM swap — critical fraud prevention signal before B2C disbursements

tools.name: mpesa_imsi_query
tools.description: Verify phone registration, SIM age, and hashed IMSI for KYC/AML compliance

tools.name: sms_send
tools.description: Send SMS to 1-1000 recipients across 15+ African telecom markets

tools.name: airtime_send
tools.description: Send airtime top-up to MTN/Safaricom/Airtel/Vodafone subscribers

envVars.name: MPESA_PASSKEY
envVars.description: Lipa Na M-PESA passkey. Sandbox value in README.

envVars.name: MPESA_SANDBOX
envVars.description: true for sandbox (default), false for production

envVars.name: MPESA_INITIATOR_NAME
envVars.description: Required for B2C, B2B, reversals, balance, transaction status

envVars.name: MPESA_RESULT_URL
envVars.description: Async result delivery URL (defaults to MPESA_CALLBACK_URL)

envVars.name: MPESA_OFFICIAL_CONTACT
envVars.description: Business phone for Bill Manager enrolment

envVars.name: AT_USERNAME
envVars.description: Africa's Talking username. Use 'sandbox' for testing.
